nom: Good Molecules Dark Spot Microdart Patches

avis.texte: After two days of using the pactches left dark circles around scar and hasnt gone away

For mid to mature adults you need something stronger, derm grade ingredients to really penetrate. This does not have that. You are better off spending more money and getting a product like Roc skincare even tone which says goes 10 layers deep or something similar.

I've got some stubborn acne scarring on my cheeks, which has darkened since I've been tanning in the summer. These patches worked surprisingly well. After 4 nights of use, I saw a significant difference in the darkness of the spots.

They felt like they were going to work, but after applying to my bare face as soon as i try to put on any moisturizer on my face the patches begin to peel off immediately and became unusable. I perfer the Star micodart ones to these.
Ive been using this product on two spots ans i actively notice a difference
